name: Santou Suzuko
source:
A young girl and the sole daughter of a wealthy person from a mountain village that [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] happened to visit.

Her father and household members bring her up like a princess and overprotect her, yet for some reason she lives closed in a storeroom in a corner of the magnificent mansion. There are chains attached to her wrist and ankle.

Santou does not, however, show much curiosity about the outer world. The reason is probably that there are no inconveniences in her luxurious storeroom. She is a pure young lady, uncorrupted by the unhappiness of the outside world, almost like a precious hidden pearl, and yet...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
